defects.visible_symptom: Completed C1/C2 slices reported unrelated T05 families as missing and collapsed group scores to zero.
defects.probable_root_cause: Protocol v2 enumerated the whole T05 inventory on every one-or-two-candidate slice, defined coverage globally, and paired reference families round-robin rather than to the visible candidate family.
defects.tooling_change: Protocol v3 binds exact candidate paths, a matched reference family/path, slice-local coverage, and an explicit unseen-assets-out-of-scope acknowledgment.
defects.expected_visible_result: Fresh critics evaluate only what each source-bound slice actually contains; real visible defects remain score-blocking.
defects.proof_contract: Twenty visual-integrity tests plus a fresh complete ten-job C1/C2 primary run on the unchanged source.

defects.visible_symptom: Two C2 groups truncated and one C1 job was cancelled, leaving mandatory visual coverage incomplete.
defects.probable_root_cause: The model output cap and completion contract allowed row-level truncation to exit successfully and the resolver then emitted secondary missing-hash noise.
defects.tooling_change: Constrain response length, raise the response cap, preserve failed-slice raw evidence, set execution_complete=false, exit nonzero, and report the exact row error without fabricated path errors.
defects.expected_visible_result: Every required group yields either a fully bound verdict or a precise incomplete execution; cancellations are never treated as votes.
defects.proof_contract: Fresh ten-job primary matrix with all artifacts complete and evaluator provenance clean.

defects.visible_symptom: The official single-pair C6 run produced thermal_risk 8.80268 from a 1.119732 RSS ratio, while the diagnostic baseline repeats drifted about eight percent.
defects.probable_root_cause: One sequential candidate/baseline pair cannot distinguish production RSS from runner/order drift; the first B-A-A-B verification then showed a 5.9461% baseline repeat spread with cold-cache filesystem input and major faults in baseline A but not baseline B, while the candidate repeats were stable at 1.2647%.
defects.tooling_change: Run equal discarded B-A-A-B 30-second native-4K warm-ups before the unchanged counterbalanced B-A-A-B 20-minute measurements, and fail measurement when either role's max-RSS repeat spread exceeds five percent of its mean.
defects.expected_visible_result: C6 applies the unchanged regression score only to stable counterbalanced means and preserves all four raw measurements.
defects.proof_contract: Four complete native-4K scale-1 runs with at least 300 samples each, exact condition equality, warning equality, raw hashes, repeat stability, and every unchanged C6 dimension strictly above 9.0.

defects.visible_symptom: Otherwise complete C1/C2 responses penalized required night context, approved camera reversal, close-detail framing, context actors, and an invented in-scene shipping device; single-image slices also received unsupported cross-view scores and clean slices received scores at or below 9.0 without visible defects.
defects.probable_root_cause: Protocol v3 appended whole-group instructions to slice-local prompts, exposed an ambiguous shipping-device group label, forced cross-view dimensions on single-candidate slices, showed full vertical reference frames at low feature scale, and did not require low scores or defect text to bind a visible region and exact candidate.
defects.tooling_change: Protocol v4 uses family- and condition-specific instructions, display-only device-matrix language, checksum-bound family focus crops, dynamic omission of cross-view dimensions for single candidates, and fail-closed candidate/dimension/region evidence for every score at or below 9.0.
defects.expected_visible_result: Fresh critics grade only visible T05 properties on the declared slice, while any genuine visible defect remains localized, reproducible, and score-blocking.
defects.proof_contract: Twenty-four visual-integrity tests, independent protocol review above 9/10, and a fresh complete ten-job C1/C2 primary run on unchanged production source 8c9da476ca93a7a826d51eae892449fd20e9c105.

rule: Every mandatory finding follows CRITIC SYMPTOM -> ROOT CAUSE -> PRODUCTION CHANGE -> EXPECTED VISIBLE RESULT -> REQUIRED PROOF.
